meta.title: Add context window percentage to ClickHouse
meta.body_summary: A spec-only PR proposing a new context_window_usage_percent field (UInt8) in the ClickHouse runs table to pre-calculate token usage percentage, simplifying analytical queries.

perf_labels.notes: Spec-only PR by Cursor proposing a new ClickHouse field for precomputed context window usage percentage; open with a 'not priority' comment from maintainer.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 356 changed lines, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, but it consists entirely of a design specification document. As a design-only PR, it remains open without merge, consistent with an early-stage proposal not yet ready for implementation.
